Form.description: A native `<form>` with `novalidate`. On submit it validates every enabled Field inside, prevents the submit and focuses the first invalid field when one fails, then hands the values to `onFormSubmit`, waits for it, and shows the errors it returns on their fields. A reset returns it to before its first submit.

props.validationMode: When the Fields inside validate, unless a FieldRoot sets its own: `"onSubmit"` (on submit, then on every change), `"onBlur"` or `"onChange"`. A submit always validates every field.
props.errors: Errors to show that didn’t come from a submit (a page rendered with them), keyed by field name: a message or a list of messages each. An entry is hidden once its field’s value changes, until `errors` itself changes.
props.onFormSubmit: Called on a valid submit with the values of the enabled, named Fields, keyed by name; the native submission is then prevented. It may return a promise or be an action that awaits: the form is `data-submitting` until it ends and ignores further submits. What it resolves to, if anything, is the server’s errors keyed by field name: they show on their fields and the first takes focus. An error for a field edited while the request was out is dropped.
props.onFormError: Called with the error when `onFormSubmit` throws or its promise rejects. The form can then be submitted again. Without it, the failure is reported to the page as an uncaught error.
props.onSubmit: Called with the submit event on a valid submit, before `onFormSubmit`. Without `onFormSubmit`, the native submission goes ahead unless this prevents it.

dataAttributes.data-submitting: Present while `onFormSubmit` is out. The form also has `aria-busy="true"` meanwhile.
